'''Rhus''' was a [[Nomai]] originally from [[the Vessel]] who landed on [[Ember Twin]] with [[Escape Pods|Escape Pod 2]].<ref>RHUS: Our escape pod’s passengers are afraid, but physically well, Annona; everyone survived the crash.</ref> While searching for a location to build the [[Sunless City]], Rhus found a passage that only contains rocks.<ref>RHUS: Keep moving, friends: There is nothing of interest at the end of this passage but rocks. RHUS: And while these rocks are interesting, they can wait until a less urgent time.</ref>

== Trivia ==
''Rhus'' is a genus of flowering plants commonly known as [[wikipedia:Sumac|sumac]].
